title: Front-running collectReward() allows disproportionate reward capture
description: The collectReward() function can be front-run by an attacker who stakes tokens immediately before a reward injection transaction is processed. By monitoring the mempool for incoming collectReward() calls, an attacker can sandwich their stake transaction to capture a disproportionate share of the newly injected rewards without having contributed to the staking pool for any meaningful duration.
impact: Legitimate long-term stakers receive diluted rewards as front-runners capture value they did not earn through sustained participation. This undermines the incentive mechanism and penalizes honest stakers.
attackPath: Front-run with a large stake transaction
Allow collectReward() to execute, distributing rewards
Immediately unstake to capture disproportionate reward share
recommendation: Implement a time-weighted reward distribution mechanism or add a minimum staking duration before rewards can be claimed. Consider using commit-reveal schemes or private mempools for reward injection.
